findings.detail: Series Z2 has a 12.00% all-in rate with a 6.00% PIK component, but pik_rate was published as 12.00 instead of 6.00.

rationale: The schedule total of USD 2,845.622m substantially reconciles to the extracted USD 2,845.623249m and does not identify a valuation issue. Raw source at table 18 row 10 nevertheless decides the flagged text-pathway question: the Series Z2 row states an all-in 12.00% rate with 6.00% PIK, while the reviewed artifact publishes pik_rate as 12.00. The PIK component is therefore mis-extracted and should be 6.00. Other targeted text-derived rate rows checked against the schedule were supported by their source cells.
